item.title: Lesson 72: “Holding grievances is an attack on God’s plan for salvation.”
item.description: “Holding grievances is an attack on God’s plan for salvation.” While we have recognized that the ego’s plan for salvation is the opposite of God’s, we have not yet emphasized that it is an active attack on His plan, and a deliberate attempt to destroy it.
